command: import yaml; d=yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/deploy-production.yml',encoding='utf-8')); on=d.get('on', d.get(True)); assert set(on.keys())=={'workflow_dispatch'}, 'triggers'; j=d['jobs']; assert {'plan','deploy'} <= set(j), 'jobs'; dj=j['deploy']; env=dj.get('environment'); assert (env=='production' or (isinstance(env,dict) and env.get('name')=='production')), 'environment'; n=dj.get('needs'); assert 'plan' in (n if isinstance(n,list) else [n]), 'needs'; assert dj.get('permissions',{}).get('id-token')=='write', 'deploy id-token'; assert all((v.get('permissions') or {}).get('id-token')!='write' for k,v in j.items() if k!='deploy'), 'id-token scope'; assert (d.get('permissions') or {}).get('id-token')!='write', 'top id-token'
